Create a cute, ultra-realistic, vertical 9:16 viral baby dance video using the uploaded baby image as the exact identity reference. Do not change the baby’s face in any way — preserve the same facial features, eye shape, nose, lips, cheeks, skin texture, age, hairline, hairstyle, and body proportions with perfect consistency throughout the video.
 
Scene & Environment
The baby is standing and dancing confidently in a modern indoor home setting with soft ambient lighting. The background should feel warm, clean, and family-friendly, with shallow depth of field to keep focus on the baby. Floor and surroundings should look realistic and natural, suitable for a viral home video.
 
Costume & Appearance (IMPORTANT)
Use the exact costume from the uploaded reference image:
– Dark green traditional outfit with golden embroidery
– Matching traditional pants
– Barefoot
Fabric texture, embroidery details, fit, and colors must remain realistic and unchanged. Hairstyle, skin tone, and facial expression remain true to the reference image.
 
Dance Movements (VERY IMPORTANT)
The baby performs a new sequence of adorable, viral dance steps, inspired by playful baby energy but not copying the reference exactly:
– Gentle bouncing steps in place with rhythmic knee bends
– Small joyful hops with soft landings
– One arm raised overhead while the other swings sideways, then switching arms
– Playful side-to-side steps with tiny foot slides
– Light hand waves near the face, then down toward the waist
– Cute shoulder shimmies synced with the rhythm
– Subtle hip wiggles while stepping forward and back
– Tiny spins or half-turns with balance maintained
– Brief pause with a confident baby pose, then resuming dance
– Expressive but natural baby gestures, including curious head tilts and playful seriousness
All movements must be natural baby motions — balanced, rhythmic, cute, and stable. No adult-style choreography, no extreme flexibility, no exaggerated speed.
Facial Expression & Mood
– Confident and playful baby attitude
– Occasional serious cute look, followed by excitement
– Natural blinking, soft smiles, curious expressions
– No overacting, no cartoon exaggeration
 
Camera & Style
Camera stays at baby height with a slight handheld feel for realism. Smooth motion, no shaking, no zoom jumps.
Lighting is soft, warm indoor light with realistic shadows.
Style is hyper-realistic, cinematic yet adorable, optimized for social-media virality.
 
Quality & Constraints
– High resolution, smooth animation
– No glitches, no warping, no distortion
– No face swapping errors, no identity drift
– Loop-friendly ending
– No text, no labels, no icons, no UI elements
Maintain full identity consistency of the baby from start to end.

A joyful young child dancing energetically on a slightly wet residential street after rain. The child has short black bob hair and is wearing a red sweater with thin white horizontal stripes and dark blue pants. The child smiles brightly and performs playful hand gestures and rhythmic arm movements, moving side to side in a carefree, fun manner.

The background shows a shallow depth of field with a blurred street, a parked car on the left, a few pedestrians walking away in the distance, and greenery along the roadside. The ground is slightly reflective from recent rain.

Natural lighting, overcast sky, soft daylight. Camera is handheld or lightly stabilized, medium shot framing, slightly cinematic motion. Subtle motion blur from dancing.

Style: realistic, candid street moment, vibrant but natural colors, high detail, 4K quality.

Motion: smooth continuous dancing loop, hair bouncing slightly, arms crossing and swinging rhythmically.

Camera movement: slight forward tracking or gentle handheld sway to enhance realism.

Create a short, clear, kid-friendly dance tutorial video of a cheerful cartoon character (kid / monkey / dog / any cute character) standing facing the camera. The full body must be visible. The camera is fixed in front view.
 
🕺 Dance Steps (in order):
 
The character steps left foot to the side and raises both hands up in the air
 
The character steps right foot to the side while keeping hands up
 
The character waves both hands happily two times
 
The character claps hands once above the head
 
Then the character starts moving the whole body in a big circular motion
 
While spinning, the hands stay up and move with the body
 
The character completes one or two full circle turns (twirling in place)
 
After spinning, the character does small marching steps in place (left foot, right foot, left, right)
 
Then the character does two side steps with light knee bends like a cute dance bounce
 
The character shakes hips left and right two times
 
The character raises both hands again and repeats the full sequence
 
🔁 Animation Behavior:
 
All full body movements and leg steps are very clear and easy to understand
 
Movement is slow, smooth, and kid-friendly
 
No fast spinning, no motion blur
 
Each step is clearly separated and easy to copy
 
The animation loops perfectly
 
Style is fun, cute, and energetic
 
🌈 Visual Style:
 
Background: Bright, colorful, playful (kids learning game style)
 
Character: Cute, friendly, smiling
 
Animation: Smooth, clean, simple
 
Lighting: Bright and cheerful
 
📷 Camera:
 
Fixed camera
 
Front view
 
Full body always visible.

Animate the input baby image into a 5-second pro Garba-ballet dance: Asian baby with spiky black hair, big eyes in sparkly, headband on white couch in modern living room. Sequence: graceful arm extensions sweeping right-to-left/left-to-right, pointed toe pliés/relevés, gentle pirouettes, circular clockwise Garba spins moving around couch area, followed by sharp hand claps synced with leg taps and hip sways, joyful smiles, expressive face tilts. Smooth realistic motion, exact features, high detail, 4K, front camera subtle circle, viral style.
